## GET `/api/2.29/keytabs/download`

**Tier:** T0  

Download a Kerberos keytab file. The file can be downloaded in the native binary format or a base64 encoded format. If not specified, defaults to binary.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `KeytabFileResponse`

## POST `/api/2.29/keytabs/upload`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Upload a Kerberos keytab file to the array. The file can be uploaded in the native binary format or a base64 encoded format. If not specified, defaults to binary. The procedure to upload a file may vary depending on the type of REST client.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `name_prefixes` | query | string |  | The prefix to use for the names of all Kerberos keytab objects that are being created. |

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `keytab_file` | `Keytab_file` | The keytab file to upload. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `KeytabFileResponse`
